`library` is defined both as a member in class `link.thesymbolic.jetcommand.JetCommandApp` and an extension in package `link.thesymbolic.jetcommand`. The defined behavior for this is to use the member, but since the extension is explicitly imported into this file, there's a chance that this was not expected. (One common way this happens is for members to be added to a class after code was already written to use an extension).
